# Changing a table's shape

The six verbs work down a table. Sometimes the table is the wrong shape to begin
with: a year in four columns when you wanted a year in four rows, or the reverse.

Two verbs turn a table one way and back. `lengthen` makes it taller and `widen`
makes it wider, and the names say which, because nobody could remember which of
`melt` and `cast` did what.

This is the part where a reader arriving from tidyr will recognize the job and
not the argument list. There is a table in the first chapter comparing the two.
